observations: Photo 0: front panel of an off-white office photocopier wrapped in stretch film, with 'SHARP' and 'AR-M207' printed clearly on the front.
Photo 1: side view of the same copier, 'digital' badge, Energy Star sticker, Sharp AR-M207 text on the front, two paper trays marked A4 and A3.
Photo 2: top view through the wrap showing the document glass area and cover; Sharp AR-M207 on the front again.
Plastics show yellowing and scuffs under the wrap, consistent with a used office machine.
No control panel lit, no test print, no page counter, no rear label shown; dealer watermark on all photos; stacked on a pallet with other stock.

claims.evidence: Model text readable on the front in photos 0, 1 and 2.
Import history cannot be shown by photos.
Photos 1 and 2 show yellowed, scuffed plastics typical of a used machine.
Internal service history cannot be seen; copiers are routinely serviced.
No power-on clip, no test copy, no counter readout.
No receipt or warranty shown; unlikely for a UK-used copier.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on, may jam, or print with streaks from a worn drum or fuser
risks.proof: Clip of it powering on and making a copy, showing the printed page with a handwritten code in shot

risks.risk: Very high page count meaning drum, developer and fuser near end of life
risks.proof: Photo of the counter or a printed configuration and counter report

risks.risk: Toner cartridge, drum or paper trays missing
risks.proof: Photo with the front cover open showing toner and drum fitted

risks.risk: Cracked document glass or broken cover hinges under the wrap
risks.proof: Unwrapped photo of the glass with the cover lifted
risks.if_unproven: as needing glass or cover parts

proof_requests: Clip of it powering on and making a copy with a handwritten code in shot
Photo of the page counter or a printed counter report
Photo with the front cover open showing toner and drum
Unwrapped photo of the document glass
response.reason: Sharp AR-M207 is read clearly in photos 0 to 2, so it is priced at its worst case as a used copier not working with high count until a working copy clip and counter report are shown.
